document.name: World Ice Arena Flushing Learn to Skate
document.shortDescription: Learn to Skate classes in Flushing for ages 2 and up, with Thursday through Sunday sessions at World Ice Arena.
document.longDescription:
World Ice Arena's official skating school page describes a Learn to Skate program in Flushing Meadows Corona Park at 131-04 Meridian Road, Flushing, with phone 718-760-9001. The official page says the program follows the Learn to Skate USA curriculum and serves all ages and abilities, while the current brochure result includes Parent and Me for ages 2-3, Snowplow Sam classes for ages 4-6, Basic classes for ages 7-14, and adult tracks.

The published schedule includes Thursday afternoon sessions beginning at 3:45 PM, Friday evening sessions, Saturday morning and afternoon sessions, and Sunday morning sessions. That supports weekday, weekend, morning, afternoon, evening, and after-school tags without needing to infer beyond the published class table.

Sources: https://www.worldice.com/skating-school/ https://www.worldice.com/contact/ https://www.worldice.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/24-25-LTS-Brochure-v23.pdf https://www.worldice.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/World-Ice-Arena-1024x583.png
